summary: Skier caught in avalanche on west side of Loveland Pass while traversing toward the Butt Crack chute; carried 200-300 ft including ~50-ft cliff drop, buried to waist with minor injuries; companion reached him in ~10 min; SCRG, Summit County Sheriff's Office, C-RAD team, Arapahoe Basin Ski Patrol and Flight for Life Colorado responded but were not needed - both skiers skied out on their own.
location: West side of Loveland Pass, Butt Crack chute
notes: INSERT run999; victim minor injuries, buried to waist; responders stood down, both skied out on their own.
